name: quantum-aether
description: Post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768 / ML-KEM) auditing, hidden server-preference downgrade detection, Ed25519 signed receipts, CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM, and copy-paste remediation configs.

interface.longDescription:
Audit whether any public domain, API, or remote MCP server actually negotiates hybrid post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768 / ML-KEM, FIPS 203) with real browsers.

Quantum Aether detects both classical endpoints and hidden server-preference downgrades (where tools like SSL Labs report PQ support but Chrome/Firefox still receive classical X25519), generates copy-paste Nginx/Apache/HAProxy/Cloudflare fixes, and issues offline-verifiable Ed25519 signed TLS receipts for NIS2/DORA/BSI TR-02102-2 documentation.
defaultPrompt: Audit example.com for post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768) and explain any server-preference downgrade.
Generate a copy-paste Nginx configuration to enable X25519MLKEM768 ahead of classical curves.
Produce NIS2/DORA transport encryption evidence with an offline-verifiable Ed25519 signed receipt.
Check whether our remote MCP servers protect agent traffic with post-quantum TLS.
